text:
alex: Heads-up team: scheduling a hotfix deploy at 11:30 PDT to fix an emoji tokenization edge-case that can insert stray chars in /generate and /chat. Plan to pin api -> redwood/api:3.1.2-hotfix and model-server -> redwood/model-server:3.1.2-hotfix. Need: short RN blurb, internal announce copy, confirm rollback lanes.
maria: I can take the RN blurb. Quick Q: should customer-facing copy mention endpoints? I'm leaning yes but keep it non-alarming.
alex: Mention endpoints and impact (some emoji sequences). No downtime. Keep tone calm.
tim: Ops rollback lanes:
- Rollback A: revert model-server to :3.1.1 and api to :3.1.1 (fast image rollback)
- Rollback B: shift traffic away from primary region to standby region + scale canary to 0%
Also have manual DB-read-only fallback if errors cascade.
jen: Internal announce short: "Hotfix rollout v3.1.2-hotfix at 11:30 PDT to address rare emoji tokenization in generation flows. Oncall: robert-oncall. If you notice regressions, escalate to #eng-oncall immediately." I'll post once RN link is available.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alex for 2026-05-02T18:30:00Z. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 1767801234`. Canary pool: frontend-canary-a, model-pool: gpu-hotfix-2.
maria: RN draft: "Rolling out v3.1.2-hotfix to correct tokenization for certain emoji sequences that could produce stray characters in generated text on /generate and /chat. This is a targeted fix; most customers will not notice any change. No downtime expected. If you see unexpected behavior, contact #support and tag @eng-oncall."
alex: Good. Add a 1-liner internal ops section with owners + rollback commands. Also pin in staff digest.
tim: Pre-deploy checklist: 1) run KV cache priming job 2) smoke test on canary 3) confirm alert thresholds (error rate >2% or latency >2x) 4) ensure deploy-bot playbook open.
maria: Pin commands for the window:
```
# API
kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:3.1.2-hotfix -n prod
# Model
kubectl set image deployment/model-server model-server=redwood/model-server:3.1.2-hotfix -n prod
```
alex: Thanks. Robert, you'll be oncall?
robert-oncall: Oncall and watching. If error rate >2% for 5m or latency >2x baseline, I'll start Rollback A. I'll also keep an eye on memory and p95 latency.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started at 2026-05-02T18:30:25Z. Health checks: 3/3. Traffic: 10% canary.
robert-oncall: Canary metrics look clean: error rate 0.05%, latency 1.05x baseline.
tim: After 5m and green health, we'll run KV primer and move to 50%.
jen: Internal announcement copy ready to go. Will paste once we hit 50%.
deploy-bot: Traffic moved to 50% at 2026-05-02T18:36:10Z.
robert-oncall: KV priming job executed, minor memory uptick but stable. No error spikes.
alex: Proceed to 100% if stable for 3m.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% completed at 2026-05-02T18:40:05Z. Canary checks passed.
robert-oncall: Monitoring post-rollout window. So far stable for 10m. Will extend to 30m for safety.
maria: RN posted to internal docs: https://internal/docs/rn/v3.1.2-hotfix. Added owners, rollback steps, and the exact pin commands. Pinned in staff digest.
jen: Announcement posted in #general and #eng. Short summary + link to RN and ops playbook.
alex: Great work. If we need a postmortem later, we'll open a separate thread and link here. Closing this thread after the monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
